Le Soir d'Algerie reports that Algeria's ANPDP announced on 11 November 2026 its Deliberation No. 05 on personal data in CVs, taken under Law 18-07.
The ANPDP issued Deliberation No. 05 of 11 November 2026 setting CV data rules under Law 18-07, per Le Soir d'Algerie.
